background.$description: Light page background: pure white, the page ground only (style unify, 2026-09-22, Elleta).

dont: Not a surface, card or chip fill

background-inverse.$description: Inverse dark section on a light page.

usage: full-bleed dark sections embedded in a light layout

surface.$description: Raised card surface on ground. Cards separate from the page by lift and warmth, not darkness.

surface-card.$description: Flat card fill: panel #f2f2f2 on the white page (style unify, 2026-09-22, Elleta).

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-09-19: text-primary 14.83:1, text-secondary 7.69:1 (AAA); text-muted 4.64:1, text-accent 5.22:1 (AA normal text).

surface-elevated.$description: Highest light surface. Same value as surface, light-mode elevation is shadow-borne (portfolio contract); dark mode steps values instead.

surface-inset.$description: Recessed surface on ground, wells, tracks, inset panels.

surface-inverse.$description: Raised surface inside dark embedded blocks on light pages.

surface-glass.$description: Primary glass surface. Ground shows through the warm white. Pair with border-glass-top, shadow.raised, and blur.surface.

a11y.contextRequirement: Parent background must be ground or lighter. Text on glass: ink only. Do not stack glass over saturated fills.
Parent background must be ground or lighter. Text on glass: ink only.

surface-glass-light.$description: Lightest glass. Subtle secondary panels and nested containers.

a11y.contextRequirement: Parent background must be ground or lighter. Text on glass: ink only.
State backgrounds only, never a default surface. Text on it: ink.

border-glass-top.$description: Top highlight on a frosted panel, mimics natural light on glass.

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-09-22: 18.73:1 on bg, 16.73:1 on panel (worst). AAA.
Verified 2026-09-22: 7.94:1 on bg, 7.09:1 on panel (worst). AAA.
Verified 2026-09-22: 7.94:1 on bg, 7.09:1 on panel (worst). AAA. Same value as text-secondary: one muted step.

text-inverse.$description: Text on dark surfaces inside light pages.

usage: headings and body inside embedded dark sections

text-accent.$description: Accent text, iris. At body scale this reads INTERACTIVE (colour affordance rule); use only where the interactive read is intended.

dont: Not on eyebrows, headings or decoration: iris means interactive (links, focus) and only that
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-09-22: 6.23:1 on bg, 5.56:1 on panel (worst). AA. Interactive only.

accent.$description: The single accent, light mode. Interactive fills, outlines, links, focus.

dont: Never pair with a second accent
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21: ground label on iris fill 5.66:1 (AA); iris as non-text on light surfaces ≥5.25:1 (passes 3:1).

accent-hover.$description: Accent hover fill, iris darkened one step.

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21: ground label on this 7.09:1, AAA.

accent-border.$description: Iris border wash for accent-adjacent chrome.

dont: Never an input or control border: use border-strong

border-subtle.$description: Hairline divider, decorative only (style unify, 2026-09-22, Elleta).

border-faint.$description: Hairline card edge, decorative only (style unify, 2026-09-22, Elleta).

dont: Never the sole boundary of an interactive control

border-strong.$description: Control border, 3:1: inputs, selects and controls (style unify, 2026-09-22, Elleta).

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-09-22: 3.36:1 on bg, 3.00:1 on panel (worst). Non-text AA.

border-ink.$description: 1px ink stroke: diagram frames, the pressed chip, ink rules (style unify, 2026-09-22, Elleta).

focus-ring.$description: Focus ring: the one coloured stroke (style unify, 2026-09-22, Elleta; colour never in strokes, except the focus ring).

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-09-22: 6.23:1 on bg, 5.56:1 on panel. Non-text AA.

usage: The one highlighted thing per diagram
dont: Never a stroke or text colour
Never a stroke or text colour
Never a stroke or text colour

chip-text.$description: Text on chip fills (style unify, 2026-09-22, Elleta).

link.$description: Default link color, ink. Link affordance is underline; hover turns iris.

dont: Do not color-only distinguish links — always pair with underline

link-hover.$description: Link hover, iris. The interactive color arriving on intent.

success.$description: Success state, CARRIED from April pending a status-palette decision. Decorative / icon / border only (verified 4.33:1 on ground, fails AA text).

info.$description: Info state, CARRIED from April pending a status-palette decision. Chip wash / border only (verified 2.87:1 on ground, fails all thresholds).

accent-raised-hi.$description: Raised accent plate, top gradient stop (keycap). Light source upper-left: top is the lighter stop.

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-22: text-on-accent (ground) label on this stop 5.66:1, AA normal text. Worst stop of the plate; the bar holds on every stop. Portfolio divergence recorded: the plate runs one step deeper than the portfolio keycap (iris.hi top failed the ground label at 4.49:1; the white label is not carried, no pure white).

accent-raised-lo.$description: Raised accent plate, bottom gradient stop (keycap).

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-22: ground label on this stop 7.09:1, AAA.

accent-raised-hover.$description: Raised accent plate on hover and focus-visible: the plate settles onto its deep stop, flat.

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-22: ground label on this stop 7.09:1, AAA.

accent-raised-edge.$description: Raised accent plate edge (the keycap 3D rim).

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-22: 7.25:1 on ground, non-text edge, far above the 3:1 minimum.

accent-ink.$description: Accent used as TEXT on the mode's page ground.

bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-21: 5.66:1 on ground, AA normal, AAA large.

floating.$description: Default floating-panel shadow. Semantic alias over primitive shadow.soft.

raised.$description: Primary raised card shadow. Semantic alias over primitive shadow.layered.
